summary: Added create-view/drop-view support for /-/execute-write. In datasette/default_actions.py registered Action create-view (cv, DatabaseResource) after create-table and drop-view (dv, TableResource) after drop-table. In datasette/write_sql.py added create/view (UnsupportedWriteSqlOperation when no database, else create-view on DatabaseResource) and drop/view (drop-view on TableResource) cases. In datasette/utils/sql_analysis.py renamed dropped_tables to dropped_tables_and_views and included drop/view keys so the spurious delete on a dropped view is suppressed. In docs/authentication.rst added create-view/drop-view to the --root write-permissions list and new action sections in the requested positions. Check command tests/test_queries.py passes (90 passed); related action and sql-analysis tests also pass.
concerns: Verify the missing-prefix message for drop view with no database/table falls through to the standard unsupported message as intended.
Confirm no other code referenced the old dropped_tables name (grep found none).
